criteria.evidence: Benefit hypothesis, Boundary (In/Out/Out later/Never), five Guiding rules, two Functionalities and an Agent intent block are all present and substantive, e.g. "Never: show a cart as abandoned when an order was placed from it."

"Out: reminding the customer behind a cart ... owns that, together with the consent and no-spam rules. This list only shows; keeping it free of any outreach is what lets it stay a plain, trustworthy view." Every boundary line and rule carries its reason.
Boundary, rules and functionalities are discrete bullets; the benefit hypothesis follows the As a / we believe / we will know shape.

Domain says only "Seeing today's abandoned carts ... gives each shop owner a clear view"; the capability adds the abandonment definition, per-day time-zone rule, 5-minute freshness, row contents and two functionalities.

"A cart belongs to the day it became abandoned, counted in the shop's own time zone." and "its length is waiting on the owner's answer (memory update mu-20261020-002), so the docs refer to it as 'the abandonment window'." A cold reader can state what, why and edges; the open window length is flagged openly rather than hidden.
